headline: Revenue surges on AI-driven demand, guidance raised
summary_short: Ciena's fiscal Q2 2026 revenue rose 39.5% y/y to $1.571 billion, with GAAP diluted EPS of $1.49 (vs $0.06 a year ago) and net income of $218.2 million; the company also raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $6.3 billion plus or minus $100 million.
summary_long: Revenue grew 39.5% y/y to $1.571 billion, led by Optical Networking (+42% y/y, ~73% of the revenue increase). GAAP gross margin expanded 380bp to 44.0% and operating margin rose to 15.1% from 2.9%, as operating expense grew just 8.0% against 39.5% revenue growth. GAAP diluted EPS was $1.49 versus $0.06 a year ago; adjusted diluted EPS was $1.64, up 290%. Net income was $218.2 million. Ciena repurchased $83.1 million of stock and held cash and short-term investments of ~$1.2 billion. Ciena guided fiscal Q3 2026 revenue to $1.625 billion plus or minus $50 million and raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $6.3 billion plus or minus $100 million, a 32% y/y increase at the midpoint.
